nl.tagline: Spelling- en grammaticacontrole die ook goed Nederlands kent
nl.description: LanguageTool, van een Duits bedrijf, controleert spelling, grammatica en stijl in meer dan 25 talen, waaronder Nederlands. Werkt in de browser, Word, e-mail en desktop, en kan zinnen herformuleren. Het jaarabonnement is opvallend goedkoop.
notFor: Wie vooral complete teksten wil laten genereren
limitations: Maandelijks betalen is veel duurder dan jaarlijks

en.tagline: Spelling and grammar checker that also knows Dutch well
en.description: LanguageTool, from a German company, checks spelling, grammar and style in more than 25 languages including Dutch, German and French. It works in the browser, Word, email and desktop, and can rephrase sentences. The annual plan is notably cheap.
bestFor: Error-free texts in Dutch, German or French
notFor: People who mainly want full texts generated
limitations: Monthly billing is much more expensive than annual
